request.style: English, female jazz voice, upright bass, piano, brushed drums, muted trumpet, warm and earnest, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
If we have food and clothing we are content
Those who want to get rich fall into a trap
Many senseless desires plunge people into ruin
A trap for the soul and a harmful desire

[Pre-Chorus]
Love of money is a root of all kinds of evil
Reaching for it they have wandered away from faith
Pierced through with many sorrows and deep despair
They have lost their way in the world of pain

[Chorus]
Flee from all this man of God today
Pursue righteousness and godliness and faith
Endurance and love and gentleness keep close
Hold on to the life that is yours to keep

[Verse]
Fight the good fight of the faith with all your might
Take hold of the eternal life you were called to
You made the good confession before many witnesses
Stand firm in the truth that you have received

[Chorus]
Flee from all this man of God today
Pursue righteousness and godliness and faith
Endurance and love and gentleness keep close
Hold on to the life that is yours to keep

[Bridge]
In the presence of God who gives life to all
Before Christ Jesus who confessed before Pilate
Keep this command without stain or any reproach
Until the appearing of our Lord Jesus

[Chorus]
Flee from all this man of God today
Pursue righteousness and godliness and faith
Endurance and love and gentleness keep close
Hold on to the life that is yours to keep

[Outro]
King of kings and Lord of lords forever
Blessed and only Sovereign of all the earth
